orders_limit_price_shape.name: orders_limit_price_shape
orders_limit_price_shape.value: ("orders"."type" = 'LIMIT' AND "orders"."limit_price_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."limit_price_cents" > 0) OR ("orders"."type" = 'MARKET' AND "orders"."limit_price_cents" IS NULL)

orders_max_spend_shape.name: orders_max_spend_shape
orders_max_spend_shape.value: ("orders"."type" = 'MARKET' AND "orders"."side" = 'BUY' AND "orders"."max_spend_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."max_spend_cents" > 0) OR (NOT ("orders"."type" = 'MARKET' AND "orders"."side" = 'BUY') AND "orders"."max_spend_cents" IS NULL)

orders_status_fill_consistent.name: orders_status_fill_consistent
orders_status_fill_consistent.value:
("orders"."status" = 'FILLED' AND "orders"."filled_quantity" = "orders"."quantity")
        OR ("orders"."status" = 'OPEN' AND "orders"."filled_quantity" = 0)
        OR ("orders"."status" = 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' AND "orders"."filled_quantity" > 0 AND "orders"."filled_quantity" < "orders"."quantity")
        OR ("orders"."status" = 'CANCELLED' AND "orders"."filled_quantity" < "orders"."quantity")
        OR ("orders"."status" = 'REJECTED' AND "orders"."filled_quantity" = 0)

position_ledger_ref.name: position_ledger_ref
position_ledger_ref.value: ("position_ledger"."reason" = 'ISSUANCE' AND "position_ledger"."issuance_id" IS NOT NULL AND "position_ledger"."trade_id" IS NULL) OR ("position_ledger"."reason" IN ('TRADE_BUY', 'TRADE_SELL') AND "position_ledger"."trade_id" IS NOT NULL AND "position_ledger"."issuance_id" IS NULL)

users_login_capability.name: users_login_capability
users_login_capability.value: ("users"."account_type" = 'MARKET_MAKER' AND "users"."password_hash" IS NULL AND "users"."role" = 'USER') OR ("users"."account_type" = 'HUMAN' AND "users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL)
